name: Menthi Kura Pappu
subtitle: toor dal cooked with fenugreek leaves, bitter and soft and eaten every week

ingredients.note: bitter; do not try to cook it out, it is meant to be there

prepNotes: Wash the fenugreek in several changes of water. Grit hides in the leaf and there is no rescuing it later.
The dal should be soft enough to smear, not soupy.

steps.text: Pressure cook the dal with the turmeric, tomato, onion, green chilli and 500ml water for 4 whistles, or simmer 40 minutes.
Stir in the fenugreek leaves and the tamarind and simmer 10 minutes uncovered until the leaves are soft.
Mash the dal roughly against the side of the pan. Season.
steps.tip: Roughly. A completely smooth dal loses the texture of the leaf.

steps.text: Heat the oil, splutter the mustard seeds, then the cumin, dried chillies, garlic, curry leaves and asafoetida.
Pour the tempering over the dal, stir once, and cover for 5 minutes before serving.

storage: Keeps 3 days refrigerated. It thickens considerably; loosen with hot water and re-season. Do not freeze, the leaves turn slimy.
